text:
ITEM 1 | Dark green leafy greens, broad and crinkled leaves with thin pale stems, lightly glossy and moist-looking, spread in an irregular mound covering roughly 60% of a white square plate (plate about 26 cm across), piled about 2-3 cm high at the center and thin at the edges | 110
ITEM 2 | Thin red bell pepper strips, about 4-6 cm long and 0.5 cm wide, bright red-orange with slightly glossy skin, scattered throughout the greens and clustered in a few spots, lying flat or angled on top of the leaves | 30
ITEM 3 | Pale yellow-green slivers, thin shreds about 3-5 cm long, crisp-looking and fibrous, mixed among the leaves near the upper left, sitting flat on the greens | 8
ITEM 4 | Glossy, slightly oily light dressing or sauce visible as sheen on the leaves and pepper pieces, no pooling on the plate surface, covering the greens lightly | 6
